findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_dataset, get_download_instructions, get_access_instructions, search, fetch, catalog_search, run_artifacts, get_artifact_download · Private data: get_access_instructions, search, fetch, catalog_search, list_my_datasets, register_recipe, run_artifacts, write_note, list_source_credentials · Public sink: query_table, catalog_search, start_run, get_run, list_source_credentials · Destructive: catalog_search, create_dataset, get_my_dataset, start_run, confirm_run, cancel_run, get_run, run_events, query_run, run_artifacts, write_note, get_table.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_dataset, get_download_instructions, get_access_instructions, search, fetch, catalog_search, run_artifacts, get_artifact_download · Private data: get_access_instructions, search, fetch, catalog_search, list_my_datasets, register_recipe, run_artifacts, write_note, list_source_credentials · Public sink: query_table, catalog_search, start_run, get_run, list_source_credentials · Destructive: catalog_search, create_dataset, get_my_dataset, start_run, confirm_run, cancel_run, get_run, run_events, query_run, run_artifacts, write_note, get_table

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
